mode.fulfilment: A protocol that strips DOI, creator metadata and cross-links from content on egress so that its influence persists in retrieval without attribution exists and operates, built by anyone.
mode.basis_quote:
SPXD requires:


**Intentional blurring** — strip names, dates, DOIs on egress. The content enters the interstice without identifying marks.


**Ephemeral identifiers** — a one-time token that expires when the leak decays. The token is not a permanent address; it is a temporary pass that self-destructs.


**Provenance erasure** — store only "leaked from somewhere in this neighborhood," not which cell.
mode.note: Section VII specifies the protocol by its required operations (intentional blurring, ephemeral identifiers, provenance erasure); no source statement of mode.
